compatibility.deduplication_rule: Preserve every legacy effect and add each newly owned rank increment once. New ranks are extra growth; do not regrant donor bits or rerun donor effects. Multi-target mechanics remain one activation even if legacy and new rank both own the same mode.

selection.campaign_partition: campaign_id including independent secret campaign7; not race
selection.proof: Before pick30 at most floor(29/3)=9 of13 families are complete, leaving at least4 candidates.12 families fail after27 picks.
selection.availability: Prefer current mission's available roles; do not hard-filter to fewer than4 eligible families. Production and unit requirements must still be checked.
selection.no_production_economy: Do not offer production-only effects; skip/defer according to the implementation's explicit rule.
